_about: Map content. map = SVG px (viewBox 1100x800), world = metres (x -900..1850, z -900..1100). Built by tools/build-map.py.

places.name: Yooba Town
places.hook: A town full of Yoobas, and a clock that ticks like a friendly tummy.

places.name: Seedvale
places.hook: Golden rows, a red barn and a very slow windmill.

places.name: Whistling Hills
places.hook: The wind plays the rocks like a flute.

places.name: Crumblecrown Castle
places.hook: A castle on a hill, mid-crumble, and very polite about it.

places.name: Mistwood Forest
places.hook: Giant trees, paper lanterns and a lot of mist.

places.name: Sugarsand Coast
places.hook: A port, a lighthouse and a lot of sea.

places.name: Frostcap Peak
places.hook: The highest place. The bell waits at the top.

places.name: Licorice Reach
places.hook: Always dusk. One orb left to eat.

places.name: Whispering Forest
places.hook: The big tree is humming. It is saying my name. Quietly.

places.name: Bramble Thicket
places.hook: A whole arch made of brambles! I'll go through slowly.

places.name: Mossy Ruins
places.hook: One arch still stands up straight. It has been waiting a very long time.

places.name: Flower Meadow
places.hook: A sunflower taller than the windmill! It turns to look at me.

places.name: Glowcap Grove
places.hook: The biggest mushroom in the world, glowing softly, just for me.

places.name: Boulder Canyon
places.hook: A tower of rock, stacked like pancakes. Somebody very patient made this.

places.name: Reed Marsh
places.hook: A heron on one leg on a very tall post. We are both being very still.

places.name: Windy Hilltop
places.hook: Stones in a ring on top of the world. The wind almost says words.

places.name: Glimmer Lake
places.hook: Sit still. The fish don't hurry, and neither does the lake.

places.name: Willow Water
places.hook: Seventeen lily pads. Count them in order.
